summary: Google DeepMind released version 2.1.0 of Concordia, its agent-based social simulation library, adding new components (marketplace, death, scripted game master, questionnaire simulations) and fixing several compatibility issues with the OpenAI model wrapper.

practices.reason: Teams using the OpenAI wrapper in this framework must update parameter handling to avoid crashes with newer OpenAI models like GPT-5.
practices.quote: always use temperature 1.0 for OpenAI since GPT-5 crashes for all other values.

practices.reason: New prefabs for scripted multi-agent simulations offer a concrete pattern for generating fine-tuning data via game-master-controlled scenarios.
practices.quote: An actor and a game master prefabs and required components for running a simulation that follows a strict script. This can be used for generating fine tuning data.
